documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Discussion And Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended Sep 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 27% year-on-year to INR 347 crores, with EBITDA growing 55% year-on-year to INR 90 crores and PAT rising 64% year-on-year to INR 57 crores. The construction equipment segment maintained strong momentum, contributing 45% of total revenue in Q1 FY27, while large agricultural equipment markets remained subdued. The company ended the quarter with a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores and a trailing 12-month new business order book exceeding INR 225 crores. Management expects full-year FY27 top-line growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than FY26 growth, supported by steady demand in construction and expected recovery in agriculture. Uniparts India reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with total income of INR 3,552 million and revenue growth of 27% year-on-year.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 revenue growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth delivered in FY26.
guidance.quote: keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q2 FY27 performance to be in line with Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver FY27 EBITDA margins comfortably above 20%.
guidance.quote: We are going to deliver FY27 also very comfortably over the 20% plus margin, right?

guidance.claim: Mexico operations are expected to contribute mid-single-digit million-dollar revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

guidance.claim: The Q1 performance was in line with quarter-on-quarter guidance and better than annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: Management expects growth in FY27 to be in line with what was delivered in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 to be sequentially in line with Q4 FY26 and H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1 FY27.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to operate comfortably above a 20% EBITDA margin level as volumes build through FY27.
guidance.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment momentum from H2 CY25 continued into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: On the construction equipment, the momentum that started in the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Conditions in large agricultural equipment remain subdued, with CY26 expected to mark the cyclical bottom.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture equipment demand in India continues to perform well due to government subsidy programs and higher adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket demand faced deferral due to tariff-driven price volatility and inflation, but absolute revenue remained flat year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the US and Europe is sustaining customer schedules and order visibility in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: India continues to perform well in small agriculture supported by government subsidies and rising adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: In Western markets, small agriculture growth is more measured with consumer appetite tempered by economic uncertainty.
demand_outlook.quote: In Western markets, small ag growth remains more measured.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agriculture conditions remain subdued, with leading OEMs indicating CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom.
demand_outlook.quote: Conditions remain subdued, as has been widely acknowledged across the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices moderated purchasing.
demand_outlook.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for construction equipment in North America is expected to strengthen gradually through FY27 with H2 performing better than H1.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry volumes for large tractors in North America continue to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse facility are scheduled for Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Annual organic capex requirements are estimated to remain at 2.5% to 3.5% of total revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: I think overall, if you see, even after having done that, today, our capex requirements as a business are roughly about 2.5% to 3.5% of our total revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts plans to maintain its capex in the range of 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q4 FY26 stood at INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 90 crores, growing 55% year-on-year and 10% quarter-on-quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs stood at 33.3% for the quarter, supported by a product mix change and a small inventory gain.
margins_costs.quote: There has been a small inventory gain that you will see on the face of the financials, and that's roughly about INR1 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Management targets maintaining material costs between 34% and 37% over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: The company remains confident of sustaining a 20% EBITDA margin across the business cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We are also very confident of maintaining our 20% EBITDA margin over the cycle.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts recorded an EBITDA margin of 24% for Q4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs for Q4 FY26 stood at 35% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: our material cost of 35% has now come back to where we've always said our normal material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%.

margins_costs.claim: The introduction of the new wage code in November 2025 resulted in an impact of INR 3.4 crores on profitability.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month new business order book stands at over INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore with a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month new business wins exceeded INR 225 crores, growing over 12.5% quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts held a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores at the end of Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow generated during Q1 FY27 was INR 44 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital stood at 139 days of trailing 12-month revenue as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate its strategic agenda.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts remained net debt free with a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company distributed total dividends of INR 170 crores in FY26, including a special dividend of INR 101 crores declared in Q3 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation continues to exert pressure on input costs and supply chain operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused customers and channel partners to moderate aftermarket purchases.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases in Western small ag has been tempered by economic uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred at the finishing shop of the Ludhiana facility towards the end of Q3 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fresh geopolitical escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: Mexico operations are projected to generate mid-single-digit million dollar revenue in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the fabrication vertical to become a meaningful vertical within the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects full year FY27 growth to be in line with FY26 growth levels.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to operate comfortably above the 20% EBITDA margin level as volumes build through FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.
